title: Elimination of Flux Trapping in Superconducting Circuits in Ambient Magnetic Fields
summary: Superconductor digital electronics and quantum computing with superconducting qubits are promising next-generation computing technologies. When cooled down or operated in the presence of a nonzero background magnetic field $B_r$, superconducting thin films comprising the circuits can trap magnetic vortices that can degrade circuit or qubit performance.
